title: Sum of Two Numbers
description: Given two integers, find their sum.
input_format: Two integers, A and B, separated by a space.
output_format: The sum of A and B.

title: Reverse a String
description: Given a string, reverse it.
input_format: A string S.
output_format: The reversed string S.

title: Factorial of a Number
description: Calculate the factorial of a given non-negative integer.
input_format: A non-negative integer N.
output_format: The factorial of N.

title: Palindrome Check
description: Determine if a given string is a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backward).
input_format: A string S.
output_format: Print "true" if S is a palindrome, and "false" otherwise.
constraints: 1 <= length(S) <= 100, S contains only lowercase letters.

title: Find the Maximum
description: Given an array of integers, find the maximum value.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N, the number of elements in the array. The second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
output_format: The maximum value in the array.

title: Fibonacci Sequence
description: Generate the Nth Fibonacci number. The Fibonacci sequence starts with 0 and 1, and each subsequent number is the sum of the previous two.
input_format: An integer N.
output_format: The Nth Fibonacci number.

title: Prime Number Check
description: Determine if a given number is a prime number.
input_format: An integer N.
output_format: Print "true" if N is prime, and "false" otherwise.

title: Word Count
description: Count the number of words in a given sentence.
input_format: A string S representing the sentence.
output_format: The number of words in the sentence.
constraints: 1 <= length(S) <= 1000, Words are separated by single spaces.

title: Array Sum
description: Calculate the sum of all elements in an array.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N, the number of elements in the array. The second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
output_format: The sum of the elements in the array.

title: Calculate Average
description: Calculate the average of a list of numbers.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N, the number of elements in the array. The second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
output_format: The average of the numbers, rounded to two decimal places.

title: Second Largest Element
description: Find the second largest element in an array of distinct integers.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N, the number of elements in the array. The second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
output_format: The second largest element in the array.
constraints: 2 <= N <= 100, -1000 <= array elements <= 1000, all elements are distinct.

title: Most Frequent Character
description: Find the most frequent character in a string.
input_format: A string S.
output_format: The most frequent character in S.
constraints: 1 <= length(S) <= 100, S contains only lowercase letters.

title: Check if Array is Sorted
description: Determine if a given array of integers is sorted in ascending order.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N, the number of elements in the array. The second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
output_format: Print "true" if the array is sorted, and "false" otherwise.

title: Remove Duplicates
description: Remove duplicate characters from a string.
input_format: A string S.
output_format: The string S with duplicate characters removed.
constraints: 1 <= length(S) <= 100, S contains only lowercase letters.

title: Reverse Words in a String
description: Reverse the order of words in a string.
input_format: A string S representing a sentence.
output_format: The string S with the words reversed.
constraints: 1 <= length(S) <= 1000, Words are separated by single spaces.

title: Leap Year Check
description: Determine if a given year is a leap year.
input_format: An integer Y representing the year.
output_format: Print "true" if Y is a leap year, and "false" otherwise.

title: Calculate Discount
description: Calculate the final price after applying a discount percentage to the original price.
input_format: Two numbers separated by space. The first is the original price (P), and the second is the discount percentage (D).
output_format: The final price after the discount, rounded to two decimal places.

title: Find the Smallest
description: Given an array of integers, find the smallest value.
input_format: The first line contains an integer N, the number of elements in the array. The second line contains N integers separated by spaces.
output_format: The smallest value in the array.

title: String Anagrams
description: Check if two strings are anagrams of each other.
input_format: Two strings, S1 and S2, separated by a newline.
output_format: Print "true" if S1 and S2 are anagrams, and "false" otherwise.
constraints: 1 <= length(S1), length(S2) <= 100, S1 and S2 contain only lowercase letters.

title: Find missing number
description: You are given an array of n-1 integers and integers are in the range of 1 to n. There are no duplicates in the array. One of the integers is missing. Find the missing element
input_format: The first line contains an integer N, the actual number of elements in array. The second line contains N-1 integers separated by spaces.
output_format: The missing number
